title: Nehemiah
author: Traditionally associated with Nehemiah, with possible editorial connection to Ezra.
date: After the exile, during the Persian period.
audience: The restored community in Jerusalem, encouraging faithfulness, prayer, rebuilding, and covenant renewal.
historicalSetting: Nehemiah records the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, opposition, spiritual renewal, and the people's renewed commitment to God's covenant.
keyVerse: Nehemiah 8:10 — "The joy of Yahweh is your strength."
christFocus: Nehemiah points to Christ as the true Restorer of God's people. The rebuilt city anticipates the greater restoration and security found in Him.
outline: The Word read and covenant renewed — Nehemiah 8-10
